evidence.label: Last recorded error
evidence.value: Could not fetch or decode upstream JSON: HTTPError (HTTP 403 Forbidden)

review_steps: Open the endpoint listed in the evidence section from a normal browser and record whether it responds.
If the endpoint is blocked from the scheduled runner only, record that as an infrastructure limit, not as a data discrepancy.
Keep the coverage gap visible: an outage window cannot be reported as 'no discrepancies found'.
alerts.summary: The NBA feed's first consecutive failure was recorded at 2026-10-07T18:04:06Z. The configured 15-minute alert threshold has been reached according to monitor poll times; the exact provider recovery time is unknown until a later successful poll. While it is unavailable, no comparison against it can run, so an absence of detections is not evidence that no discrepancy exists.
alerts.title: NBA source unavailable (authoritative)

cross_source_comparison.blocked_reason: fewer than two sources returned data, so cross-source comparison could not run

single_provider_arithmetic_checks.method: 2 * (FGM - 3PM) + 3 * 3PM + FTM from the provider's own box-score components

dispatch_policy: Alerts are written to data/alerts.json on every material change. Critical and high-severity alerts are additionally queued for notification as a GitHub issue by 'python3 -m monitor --dispatch-alerts --apply', which the scheduled workflow runs. Medium-severity alerts stay on the site until they escalate. An optional webhook (SCORING_DISCREPANCY_WEBHOOK_URL) can mirror dispatched alerts to Slack, Discord, or a similar endpoint; when it is not configured, notifications are GitHub-issue only and that is recorded, not assumed.
